a: Off-by-one errors often appear in loops and array indices.
Null/None dereference happens when using a missing object.
Race conditions depend on timing between concurrent operations.
Memory leaks retain unused memory until the process suffers.
Deep recursion without a base case can overflow the call stack.
Integer overflow wraps or errors when a value exceeds type limits.
Binary floating point cannot represent all decimals exactly.
Timeouts stop waiting for slow dependencies.
Exponential backoff retries with increasing delays.
Circuit breakers stop calling a failing dependency for a while.
